summary: Completed public API and responsive homepage regression testing. Core loading, imagery, capabilities, ecosystem, contact submission, mobile menu, and mobile overflow passed.

minor.issue: Accepts malformed email values such as not-an-email with HTTP 200 because ContactInquiry.email is a plain string instead of email validation.

integration_issues.issue: Partners and Careers links point to #partners and #careers, but neither target element exists, so those links do not scroll to a section.

issues: Talk to our team ghost button uses dark ink text on the dark navy hero, making its label effectively invisible at desktop and mobile widths despite the button remaining clickable.

action_items: Add #partners and #careers target sections or change those navigation links to existing anchors.
Change the hero ghost contact button text/border styling to meet contrast requirements on the dark hero.
Validate ContactInquiry.email with a proper email type and return 422 for malformed email API requests.
Check fetch response.ok before showing contact success; current frontend marks any HTTP response as success unless fetch rejects.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactModal sets sent=true without checking response.ok, so backend 4xx/5xx responses can display a false success state.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed contact inquiries and status records through public API tests; no seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop hero, nav presence, capabilities, seven ecosystem steps, all three project images, contact modal/API submission, mobile menu, and 390px overflow were tested. Retest missing Partners/Careers targets, hero contact contrast, API email validation, and non-OK contact response handling.
rca of the issue: Missing targets are structural: App.js renders the Partners section without id=partners and has no Careers section at all. Hero contact contrast comes from .button-ghost color:var(--ink) being used on the dark hero without an override. Contact false success comes from submit() awaiting fetch but never checking response.ok. Email acceptance comes from ContactInquiry.email being typed as str rather than a validated email type.
